title: ze_icebreaker
description:
Attention! 
 This map is not intended to be played on a local server. You can only play this map on the Zombie Escape server, to find out which server it is currently playing on, join us on the discord channel - 

 Map By R1cko27 

 Ported from Warface game 
 Special thanks: 
 - NiceShot
- Stepanof 
- Kuroki
- Kurumi
- Lolop 

 Straight to the point, fighters. The situation is critical. Blackwood started a real war against us. And so far we are losing. The enemy is attacking on all fronts. This is a Normandy-scale operation: we are being attacked with support from the sea and air. You must intervene urgently. 

The situation is extremely serious. This time, the enemy is determined not just to win the battle: Blackwood plans to destroy us at the root by destroying the Warface base. The loss of the headquarters is equivalent to death for us, so do not let us down.

Your squad will land on the territory adjacent to the base to strike the enemy from the flanks. Don't expect serious support: all the main forces will be involved in defending the base. Not only are the weapons stocks there, but almost the entire Warface command, including General Lee Wharton.

The enemy uses experimental types of weapons, upgraded combat helicopters and heavily armed cruisers. We are also confronted by assault squads consisting of both enemies known to us and opponents who are completely originally equipped. This is a full-scale military operation designed to wipe us off the face of the earth.

You will have to act in several stages. We do not expect that the attack will be repelled with one blow, the enemy probably has a lot of dangerous surprises in store. Be constantly on the alert and look at the sky above your head — there is reason to believe that not only seabirds and helicopters will appear there today.

 The map mechanics: 

 Launchers 
Rocket launchers will appear on the map. Aim at the target and press the 'E' button to shoot

 

 Rotorcraft 
One of the bosses on the map, destroy it in a certain time with the help of rocket launchers. The rotorcraft launches missiles, so try to stay under cover

 

 Turrets 
Blackwood launches turrets in capsules. You need to shoot down the capsules with turrets before they fall to the ground

 

 Mammoth 
Mammoth - one of the types of turrets, its feature is that to kill it you need to shoot at its back

 

 Plot: 

 Part Ⅰ 
Enemy forces are approaching our base, attack them from the flanks with rocket-propelled grenades with guided projectiles. You need to disable as many enemies as possible, concentrate fire on helicopters. To hit them, aim the missiles at the targets in flight — they will follow the crosshairs, otherwise they will pass by. And these rockets aren't a bad thing, are they?

Forget about the cruiser, we have a new problem. Blackwood has captured the missile silos, the missiles are preparing to launch. Make your way through the forest and enter the mines. Missiles are launched, Blackwood is blocking all roads, so it's going to be hot.

Capsules with turrets, vulnerable in flight, have been launched from the ship. Shoot them down in the air as fast as possible before they land. It looks like the turrets are finished, they are no longer dangerous. Now it's time to deal with this cruiser. Grab the grenade launchers and destroy the K017 with rocket launchers, then get out of there.

 Part ⅠⅠ 
So Blackwood's goal is… God… This is a city of ten million people! They will blame us for everything and create a global global crisis. We have to take control of this missile silo. You know what's at stake.

Shut down one of the hacked terminals redirecting our missiles. There is another terminal in the lower part of the mine, it is responsible for the protocols for launching missiles. Blackwood turned our security systems against us, we will have to destroy our own turrets. They blocked all the passageways, but they forgot about something — the ventilation shafts. Stop the rocket launch, after which the missiles will be under our control again.

Millions of people owe you their lives, but they are unlikely to ever find out about it. But now Blackwood will not be able to accuse us of their monstrous crime. The Blackwood attack is revenge for our recent Operation Black Shark. We have cornered the enemy and he has nowhere to go, but this only makes it more dangerous. Now Blackwood will stop at nothing.

 Part ⅠⅠⅠ 
We've lost contact with the main base, go to the radio bunker. The opponents did not miss, these are mines. The entire sector has just turned into a large minefield. Blackwood sent an experimental MG 3000 helicopter into battle. We have no information about his weapons, so be careful. You have to shoot down the helicopter before it does anything.

Another enemy bird in the sky, shoot it down. Enter the bunker and reconnect with the main base. Fighters, we need your help. The missile is no longer a threat, but we have lost contact with the other team.

The path is blocked by one of the powerful combat turrets, designed on the model of a juggernaut. Bypass the Mammoth and destroy its energy source. Go to the second mine and clarify the situation.

 Part Ⅳ 
Attention, the situation has changed. You will have to launch this rocket yourself. We will transmit the coordinates and launch codes over a closed channel. Enter them through the terminal. Our security systems are still turned against us, destroy the Porcupines.

You have completed a difficult task again and tipped the scales in our favor! We're using the new coordinates to aim missiles at enemy ships. Hopefully, every last one of them will go down.

 Part Ⅴ 
Blackwood is playing big. Enemy aircraft is going to strike at our missile silos. Everyone get ready for battle! Capsules with turrets were launched from the Blackwood ship again. It is better to shoot them down while they are in the air.

The rocket is launched, get ready. Find rocket-propelled grenade launchers and destroy the rocket ship. Thanks to
